source: data/README.md §三（本文件是它的机读镜像；人读与机读必须同源，由 tests/test_ledger_mirror.py 断言）
note: verbatim 为 null = 本轮只核到节号与语义、未逐字摘录原句。按 data/README §7.1 原句门禁，引用该键（或其 subclause）的规则只能是 diff/gray 且 severity=note。本文件不新增任何 data/README §三 之外的条款。

RFC2047-2.verbatim: An 'encoded-word' may not be more than 75 characters long, including 'charset','encoding','encoded-text', and delimiters.

ew-length-75.verbatim: An 'encoded-word' may not be more than 75 characters long, including 'charset','encoding','encoded-text', and delimiters.

header-line-76.verbatim: each line of a header field that contains one or more 'encoded-word's is limited to 76 characters.

ew-inner-space-forbidden.verbatim: An 'encoded-word' may not be more than 75 characters long, including 'charset','encoding','encoded-text', and delimiters.
ew-inner-space-forbidden.derivation: encoded-word 的形态定义排除空白：§2 规定其语法为 charset/encoding/encoded-text 三段以 '?' 分隔且整体不含 LWSP。本子项按 R1 同节口径判定（data/README §三 R3 的 §2 子项为『见 R1 所在节』）。

RFC2047-5.verbatim: 'encoded-text' MUST NOT be continued from one 'encoded-word' to another.

no-continuation-across-ew.verbatim: 'encoded-text' MUST NOT be continued from one 'encoded-word' to another.

RFC5322-2.1.1.verbatim: Each line of characters MUST be no more than 998 characters, and SHOULD be no more than 78 characters, excluding the CRLF.

line-max-998.verbatim: Each line of characters MUST be no more than 998 characters, and SHOULD be no more than 78 characters, excluding the CRLF.

RFC2046-5.1.1.verbatim: The Content-Type field for multipart entities requires one parameter, 'boundary'.

boundary-required.verbatim: The Content-Type field for multipart entities requires one parameter, 'boundary'.

boundary-max-70.verbatim: must be no longer than 70 characters, not counting the two leading hyphens.

RFC2046-5.1.2.verbatim: each nested 'multipart' entity uses a different boundary delimiter.

nested-boundary-distinct.verbatim: each nested 'multipart' entity uses a different boundary delimiter.

RFC2045-6.7.verbatim: encoded lines be no more than 76 characters long.

qp-line-max-76.verbatim: encoded lines be no more than 76 characters long.

qp-soft-line-break.verbatim: An equal sign as the last character on an encoded line indicates such a non-significant ('soft') line break.

qp-illegal-escape.verbatim: An equal sign as the last character on an encoded line indicates such a non-significant ('soft') line break.
qp-illegal-escape.derivation: 本子项是 R8 原句的**推导**：该句把行末 '=' 的唯一合法语义限定为软换行；§6.7 同时规定编码形态为 '=HH'。故 '=' 后既非行尾、也非两位十六进制时，两者皆不满足。docs/defect-catalog.md 必须同时写出推导链与『若审阅者要求更保守则降为 diff』的开关位置。

RFC2045-6.8.verbatim: Any characters outside of the base64 alphabet are to be ignored in base64-encoded data.

b64-foreign-chars-ignored.verbatim: Any characters outside of the base64 alphabet are to be ignored in base64-encoded data.
